race.comment: The well-related FARSET (1) (half to G3 winner and G1-placed Sunsets) is a former NSW galloper having his first run for the new stable but should find this easier than what he faced down south. Has placed one from one over this distance range and gets the services of leading hoop Thompson in the irons. Rates the testing material against this line-up. SPEEDY CROWN (5) just ran into one better over this track and trip on debut before being tipped out for further time to furnish. Can play a role despite the wide draw. FIDARDO (2) returned in good order with a close-up second at the Sunny Coast and will have come on with that run now under the belt. Top-three credentials. YOTEI (12) strips fitter second-up from the break and Melbourne Cup-winning rider Dolan stays on top. In the mix.
